messages.subject: Software Carpentry Bootcamp: sponsorships filled, seats still open
parts:
The 8 D-RUG sponsorships at June's Software Carpentry Bootcamp are filled, but there are still 25 (of 80) spots available for the relatively low price of $38:

http://www.eventbrite.com/e/software-carpentry-uc-davis-summer-2014-tickets-11471139487

I hope our D-RUG "fellows" will give talks next quarter on on some of the topics covered at bootcamp.

Best,

Noam
